text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh? The bell already rang, but the teacher isn't here yet? Bakushin O-chan isn't here either...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Attention, everyone! An announcement from the class president! The science teacher seems to have come down with a stomachache!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Therefore, 1st period will now be homeroom! We have permission to do recreational activities!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now then, what shall we do!? Musical chairs!? Dodgeball!? Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Party Girl Classmate
text_block_list.text: Me, me, pick meee! I got something I wanna playyy!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: The 'it' are Bourbon-chan and Rice-chan! Everyone else, run away—!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Then, let us begin!! Send that can flying!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —Kick the can, start!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Target spotted.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, found you—!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
—Shoot, I got caught!
—And I really wanted to kick the can~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Mmhh, pretty much everyone's gotten caught, huh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let us go kick the can! That way, we can rescue everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Right, but...! The taggers are on high alert! We'd need an incredible amount of speed to get past them...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! Helping those in trouble is the duty of the class president! Besides—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: When it comes to speed, I won't lose to anyone. ...Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHHIIIIIN!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And there she goes... But if it's Bakushin O-san, then maybe...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yeah, with Bakushin O-chan's speed, it'll definitely be fine! Let's believe in her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowaaaaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah, Bakushin O-san!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon-san! Bakushin O-san is heading your way...! Protect the can...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Operation Can Block. Immediately returning to initial position.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Overwhelming Bakushin speed! Achooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Instantaneous burst speed: explosive. Within predicted parameters. I will defend the can.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-san, just a little further! You're almost there...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I know how fast you are better than anyone! You've got this, Bakushin O-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Kgh... I won't make it in time...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —I'll be taking that!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CLANG—!!*)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hooray...! Amazing, that was incredible, Bakushin O-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While passing by the courtyard, I saw some horse girls playing kick the can. As I watched them, the can came rolling right to my feet.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! I'll pick up that can!
choice_data_list: That girl had incredible speed, huh?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Right? Bakushin O-chan is truly amazing.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: You understand it even more when you run together with her. That velocity, that overwhelming speed... That's why...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —She's a friend who makes me think: 'I want to leap past her someday.'
